name: com.jcooler.peripheral-battery
description: Stream Deck plugin for passive peripheral battery status and ordered device cycling

scripts.validate: npm run build && streamdeck validate com.jcooler.peripheral-battery.sdPlugin --no-update-check
scripts.pack:dry: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.jcooler.peripheral-battery.sdPlugin --dry-run --no-update-check
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.jcooler.peripheral-battery.sdPlugin --output dist --force --no-update-check
